questions.stem: 當學生規劃自己的專題時，訂定明確且可行的目標是成功的關鍵。
questions.answer: When students plan their own projects, setting clear and realistic goals is the key to success.
accepted_answers: When students are planning their own projects, setting clear and practical goals is the key to success.
When students plan their own projects, setting goals that are clear and achievable is the key to being successful.

questions.stem: 自主學習（self-directed learning）時如果遇到困難，向老師或同學請教是很重要的。
questions.answer: If students encounter difficulties during self-directed learning, it is important to consult teachers or classmates.
accepted_answers: If they run into problems during self-directed learning, it is important to ask teachers or classmates for advice.
If they have difficulties in self-directed learning, it is very important for them to ask teachers or classmates for help.

patterns: 虛主詞 It＋形容詞＋不定詞

1.explanation_zh: 「當…時」用時間副詞子句 When + S + V，子句要有主詞和動詞：When students plan their own projects。後半句的主詞是「訂定目標」這個動作，英文用動名詞片語 setting clear and realistic goals 當主詞，視為單數，動詞用 is。「可行的」是 realistic、practical 或 achievable；「成功的關鍵」是 the key to success，to 是介系詞，後面接名詞。
evidence: 當學生規劃自己的專題時
訂定明確且可行的目標是成功的關鍵
1.strategy_zh: 中文主詞是一個動作（訂定、練習、閱讀…）時，英文先把它改成 V-ing 或 to V，再接單數動詞。
hints: 切成四段：當學生規劃自己的專題時／訂定／明確且可行的目標／是成功的關鍵
標的詞彙：plan（規劃，L1）、project（專題，L2）、clear（明確的，L1）、realistic（可行的、實際的，L4）、goal（目標，L2）、key（關鍵，L1）、success（成功，L2）
句型框架：When + S + V …, V-ing … + is + the key to + N

2.explanation_zh: 「如果遇到困難」是條件子句，英文 If + 主詞 + 現在式動詞，中文省略的主詞要補上 students（或 they）；if 子句不用 will。「向老師或同學請教是很重要的」主詞是一個動作，英文最自然的寫法是虛主詞 It is important to + 原形動詞；「請教」是 consult 或 ask … for advice（help）。自主學習題目附了英文 self-directed learning。
evidence: 自主學習（self-directed learning）時如果遇到困難
向老師或同學請教是很重要的
2.strategy_zh: 「做某事是很＋形容詞的」先想 It is + adj. + to VR；要說明是誰做，就加 for + 人。
hints: 切成四段：自主學習（self-directed learning）時如果遇到困難／向老師或同學／請教／是很重要的
標的詞彙：difficulty（困難，L2）、teacher（老師，L1）、classmate（同學，L2）、consult（請教，L4）、important（重要的，L1）
句型框架：If + S + V …, it is important (for sb) + to VR …

traps.zh: 訂定明確且可行的目標
traps.literal_error: When students plan their own projects, set clear and realistic goals is the key to success.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接用動詞片語當主詞；英文要改成動名詞 setting …（或 to set …），動詞用單數 is。

traps.literal_error: When students plan their own projects, setting clear and realistic goals is the key to successful.
traps.explanation_zh: 「成功」在 the key to 後面要用名詞 success（to 是介系詞）；successful 是形容詞。

common_errors.wrong: If encounter difficulties during self-directed learning

common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文省略了主詞，if 子句要補上主詞 students（或 they）。

common_errors.wrong: If students will encounter difficulties during self-directed learning
common_errors.right: If students encounter difficulties during self-directed learning
common_errors.explanation_zh: 表條件的 if 子句用現在式表示未來，不用 will。
泛指老師和同學，可數名詞要用複數，或加冠詞 a teacher or a classmate。
「向某人求助」是 ask sb for help 或 advice，不是 ask help to sb。
不定詞片語太長時，用虛主詞 it 放在句首：it is important to …；句子不能沒有主詞。

traps.literal_error: If encounter difficulties during self-directed learning, it is important to consult teachers or classmates.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文的條件句省略主詞；英文 if 子句一定要有主詞 students（或 they）。

traps.zh: 向老師或同學請教是很重要的
traps.literal_error: If students encounter difficulties during self-directed learning, consult teachers or classmates is important.
traps.explanation_zh: 「向老師請教」是一個動作，當主詞要改成 it is important to consult …（虛主詞 it），或動名詞 Consulting …。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文條件句沒有主詞，英文要補上 students（或 they）；後半句「向老師或同學請教是很重要的」是動詞片語當主詞，英文改用虛主詞 it：it is important to consult teachers or classmates。

1.translation: When students plan their own projects, setting clear and achievable goals is the key to success.
1.explanation_zh: 「當……時」用 When 子句；「訂定目標」用動名詞片語 setting ... goals 當主詞；「可行的」用 achievable（feasible、realistic 也可）；「成功的關鍵」用 the key to success，to 是介系詞。

2.translation: If students encounter difficulties during self-directed learning, it is important for them to ask their teachers or classmates for advice.
2.explanation_zh: 「如果遇到困難」用 If ... encounter difficulties；「……是很重要的」用虛主詞 it is important for them to + V；「請教」用 ask ... for advice（ask for help 也通）。

1.translation: When students plan their own projects, setting clear and achievable goals is the key to success.
1.explanation_zh: 「當……時」用 When 引導時間副詞子句；「訂定明確且可行的目標」用動名詞片語 setting clear and achievable goals 當主詞，動詞用單數 is；「成功的關鍵」是 the key to success（to 為介系詞）。

2.translation: If you encounter difficulties in self-directed learning, it is important to ask your teachers or classmates for advice.
2.explanation_zh: 中文省略主詞，用泛指的 you；「如果遇到困難」用 If 條件句；「是很重要的」用虛主詞 it is important to + 原形動詞；「向……請教」用 ask ... for advice。信心 medium：開頭的時間或條件結構（When engaging in self-directed learning, ...）也同樣合理。

issues_zh: 中文沒有主詞，這是一般性的建議，盲譯很自然地用泛指的 you：If you encounter difficulties in self-directed learning, ... ask your teachers or classmates for advice。但第 1 部分的可接受寫法主詞只有 students／they，第 2 部分只有 teachers or classmates／their teachers or classmates，都沒有 you／your（也沒有 we／one），所以這個合理的譯法落在可接受寫法之外，評分規準偏窄。建議在第 1 部分補上 If you encounter／run into／have difficulties in self-directed learning（以及 If we ...），第 2 部分補上 your teachers or classmates。另外參考譯文 1、2 的 they 在單獨一句裡沒有前面的先行詞，讀起來略突兀。

problems: 第 2 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義
